about_the_game:
Take on the role of a brave courier rider in Windstorm: The Legend of Khiimori! Bond with your horse and tame the open wilds of 13th century Mongolia. Breed and train horses with specialized abilities to explore every aspect of this diverse and fascinating landscape.

Explore untamed land.

13th century Mongolia is the home of history’s best horse riders. The land is beautiful and vast, full of wonders and intriguing tales to uncover. Be prepared for harsh climates, steep cliffs, and amazing landscapes. Keep yourself safe from danger by strategically planning your delivery routes across the wide steppes, over snowy peaks or through the scorching desert.

Evolve your horses

Your horses will be essential in charting the expansive Mongolian landscape. Breed horses with specialized traits to overcome the many challenges along your path. Pair the best stock to breed increased capabilities across generations. Train your horses, build and maintain your bonds and unleash their full potential to become a true Yam courier rider. Enjoy unparalleled realism in lifelike equine behavior and animation, refined and approved by experts.

Build your own legacy

Gain reputation among Mongolia's inhabitants by taking on various activities and thrive as a Yam courier rider. You will be tasked with delivering packages and cargo, gathering vital items, and mastering the challenges of the open world. Quests will test your capabilities, requiring the right steed, excellent riding mastery, and thoughtful planning to succeed.

Unravel the Mystery

Discover the legend of Khiimori, the mythical “wind horse” and the spirit of the earth and sky. Experience the unbreakable bond between horse and rider, whether as a longtime fan or to discover the adventures of Windstorm for the very first time!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit or later (Windows 11 recommended for Intel 12th and 13th gen CPUs)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit or later (Windows 11 recommended for Intel 12th and 13th gen CPUs)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (8GB) / AMD RX 6700 XT (12GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
